card.name: Pronoun after an opening if-clause
card.fires_on: A subject pronoun such as they, this, it or these that comes right after a conditional or introductory clause, where the main clause begins. It often follows "if you include...", "if the earth was..." or "for a 75 kg patient".

modes.label: After an if-clause
modes.description: The pronoun starts the main clause once a conditional clause has ended, with no comma.

modes.description: The pronoun follows an introductory phrase about a case, dose or setting and starts a statement about it.
